mathematical_sources.note: Directly consulted primary research recall of the classical first-countable finite-support sigma-product Frechet-Urysohn result, credited there to Noble1970. Page6 explicitly defines lowercase sigma by FINITE support. Our independent adaptive-support proof establishes the standard COUNTABLE-support Sigma formulation and also removes the cited paper global Tychonoff assumption. This is a precise extension of the consulted restricted recall, not a claim that the paper states this exact generality or that its k_R/s_R main theorems are formalized. No novelty/priority claim. Noble original identified bibliographically; full original text was not accessible or consulted.

related_formalizations.note: Uses canonical Mathlib product/subtype topology, FrechetUrysohnSpace, seqClosure, countable support enumerations, antitone neighbourhood bases, finite intersections and coordinatewise convergence. Generic first-countable-to-FU and subspace inheritance are upstream. No equivalent arbitrary-index countable-support Sigma theorem was found at the pin. Prior HMP proves separability of bounded-size products, not this sequential closure statement.
